text:
Oliver: heads up — deploy-bot put staging canary on hold. runner OOM during artifact upload, cache lease stuck. blocking promote.
Deploy-bot: Promote paused: staging/canary failed (runner-37 OOM + cache-lease-stall).
Sarah: logs? is this a repeat of last month's lease leak? :thinking_face: 
Ben: log snippet: 
[2026-03-22T10:12:03Z] runner-37 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 14233 (python)
[2026-03-22T10:12:05Z] uploader: multipart upload failed: timeout completing parts
[2026-03-22T10:12:06Z] cache-manager: lease acquisition timeout=30s key=staging-artifact-abc123
Ben: OOM left incomplete upload -> orphaned lease. others hit it and hang.
Mariela: correlates with new test harness parallel DB fixtures change.
Oliver: options: 1) pin last-green artifact + manual promote, 2) rollback runner image, 3) targeted rerun after cleaning leases.
Sarah: try lease cleanup + rerun if quick. pinning blocks fixes.
Ben: cleanup script: scripts/ci/clean_stale_leases.sh --prefix=staging-. Risk: could remove active lock.
Ben: ran cleanup, removed 3 leases. re-run started.
CI-bot: rerun staging/canary #3421 -> failed (OOM).
Mariela: failed again -> memory regression in runner image. suggest nodepool image rollback.
Oliver: agree. rollback runner image to nodepool-image:v2026-02-18, rerun job.
Mariela: initiating nodepool rollback (~5m).
CI-bot: job #3421 requeued -> running on runner-42.
CI-bot: job #3421 -> success. artifacts uploaded and cache lease released cleanly.
Deploy-bot: staging/canary passed. manual promote available.
Oliver: decision: do not pin. rolled back runner image and validated canary. Sarah, please promote and add release note: "rolled back staging runner image to mitigate OOM during multipart uploads; no artifact changes"
Sarah: promoted and added release note. :white_check_mark: 
Ben: filed follow-up ENG-RT-1429 to revert test harness change and increase runner mem headroom.
Mariela: will monitor next two canaries. :eyes:
